dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Hello there, youngster. Here to enjoy the Moonchase Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Back in the day, we would eat Wangxiao Cakes, drink Laurel Wine, and gather together with family and friends to share our hopes for the future.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Nowadays, the number dishes to be had has grown and grown, and we aren't quite as particular as we once were — we simply eat whatever we wish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Take the opportunity to try some more of Liyue's delicacies, eh?
